description: Remove an incident and its timeline from a status page; it stops showing at once, nothing is sent to subscribers, and no tool restores it. Use it for an incident posted by mistake; to close a real one use post_status_page_update with RESOLVED. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns {"success": true}.

incident_id.description: The status page incident's uuid from list_status_page_incidents (not from list_incidents). An unknown id is a 404.

page_id.description: The status page's uuid from list_status_pages. An id that is not a status page of this organization is a 404.

name: delete_status_page_incident
title: Delete a status page incident
